goal: Stop penalizing peer addresses on networks like Tor or IPv6 when local connectivity drops on that network
Prevents nodes from incorrectly marking remote peers as bad and stopping relay due to local outages
reviewability: Ready to review with no blockers, though author is in draft investigating IPv6 auto-detection
agreement: Strong support across multiple reviewers for tracking connection success per network
Verified by testing unreachable network scenarios on mainnet with iptables (naiyoma)
Concern that unreachable addresses persist indefinitely addressed via a 7-day fallback (stratospher)
Suggested documenting the impact on address selection chance (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it prevents peer addresses on networks like Tor or IPv6 from being falsely dropped
Ensures nodes do not stop relaying good remote peers during local network connectivity outages
